macros.name: aamdefhead
macros.doc: The command \aamdefhead prints the heading for the AAM definitions subclause.

macros.name: aamfighead
macros.doc: The command \aamfighead prints the heading for the AAM diagrams subclause.

macros.name: aamfigrange
macros.doc: The command \aamfigrange{<figure range>} is used to store the activity model diagram figure range for later use.

macros.name: aamfigures
macros.doc: The command \aamfigures produces the boilerplate for the introduction to an APs AAM figure subclause.

macros.name: aamhead
macros.doc: The command \aamhead prints the heading for the AAM annex.

macros.name: aimexpressg
macros.doc: The command \aimexpressg produces the boilerplate for the introduction to an AP’s AIM EXPRESS-G model.

macros.name: aimexpressghead
macros.doc: The command \aimexpressghead prints the heading for the AIM EXPRESS-G annex.

macros.name: aimexpresshead
macros.doc: The command \aimexpresshead prints the heading for the AIM listing annex.

macros.name: aimlongexp
macros.doc: The command \aimlongexp produces the boilerplate for the introduction to the clause.

macros.name: aimlongexphead
macros.doc: The command \aimlongexphead prints the heading for the AIM expanded listing clause.

macros.name: aimshortexphead
macros.doc: The command \aimshortexphead prints the heading for the AIM EXPRESS short listing subclause.

macros.name: apaamdefs
macros.doc: The command \apaamdefs produces the boilerplate at the start of the AP subclause on AAM definitions and abbreviations.

macros.name: apaamintro
macros.doc: The command \apaamintro produces the introductory boilerplate for the introduction of the AP annex on application activity models.

macros.name: apapplobj
macros.doc: The command \apapplobj produces the boilerplate for the introduction to the clause.

macros.name: apassert
macros.doc: Print boilerplate for AP application assertions subclause.

macros.name: apconformance
macros.doc: The command \apconformance{<implementation methods>} produces the boilerplate for the introduction to the clause.

macros.name: apexpurls
macros.doc: The command \apexpurls{⟨short⟩}{⟨express⟩} prints the boilerplate for an AP annex of short names and EXPRESS schemas, where ⟨short⟩ is the URL of the short names and ⟨express⟩ is the URL of the EXPRESS code.

macros.name: apextraintro
macros.doc: The command \apextraintro produces extra boilerplate for the Introduction to an AP.

macros.name: apimpreq
macros.doc: The command \apimpreq{<schema name>} produces the boilerplate for the requirements on exchange structure.

macros.name: apinforeq
macros.doc: The command \apinforeq{<AP purpose>} produces the boilerplate for the clause.

macros.name: apmapping
macros.doc: The command \apmapping produces the boilerplate for the introduction to the AP mapping table or specification clause.

macros.name: apmappingspec
macros.doc: Print boilerplate for start of AP mapping specification subclause.

macros.name: apmaptemplate
macros.doc: Print boilerplate for start of AP mapping template subsubclause.

macros.name: applasserthead
macros.doc: The command \applasserthead prints the heading for the application assertions subclause.

macros.name: applobjhead
macros.doc: The command \applobjhead prints the heading for the application objects subclause.

macros.name: apscope
macros.doc: The command \apscope{<application purpose and context>} produces the boilerplate for the start of an AP scope clause.

macros.name: apshortexpress
macros.doc: Print boilerplate for AP AIM EXPRESS short listing.

macros.name: apshortnames
macros.doc: The command \apshortnames produces the boilerplate for the introduction to the AP short name annex.

macros.name: armhead
macros.doc: The command \armhead prints the heading for the ARM annex.

macros.name: armintro
macros.doc: The command \armintro produces the boilerplate for the introduction to the ARM figures.

macros.name: body
macros.doc: The command \body prints the underlined Template body header.

macros.name: confreqhead
macros.doc: The command \confreqhead prints the heading for the conformance requirements clause.

macros.name: impreqhead
macros.doc: the command \impreqhead prints the heading for implementation method-specific reguirements.

macros.name: inforeqhead
macros.doc: The command \inforeqhead prints the heading for the information requirements clause.

macros.name: mapattribhead
macros.doc: Starts an application object attribute mapping subsubsubsubclause.

macros.name: mapobjecthead
macros.doc: Starts an application object mapping subsubsubclause.

macros.name: mappinghead
macros.doc: The command \mappinghead prints the heading for the mapping table or mapping specification subclause.

macros.name: mapuofhead
macros.doc: Starts a UoF mapping subsubclause.

macros.name: parameters
macros.doc: The command \parameters prints the underlined Parameter definition header.

macros.name: picsannex
macros.doc: The command \picsannex produces the boilerplate for the start of the AP PICS annex.

macros.name: signature
macros.doc: The command \signature prints the underlined Mapping signature header.

macros.name: sstemplates
macros.doc: The command \sstemplates prints the two subclauses for the subtype and supertype templates.

macros.name: uofhead
macros.doc: The command \uofhead prints the heading for the UoF subclause.

envs.name: apconformclasses
envs.doc: The environment \begin{apconformclasses}<item list>\end{apconformclasses} provides some additional boilerplate.

envs.name: apuof
envs.doc: The environment \begin{apuof}<item list>\end{apuof} produces the boilerplate for the introduction to the clause.
